description: Design-system FOUNDATION: resolve dependencies (bundled Inter + IBM Plex Mono fonts, Lucide icon package), add shared_core flutter:/dev_dependencies/analysis_options config, and build the full token+theme layer (colors, VeriqooTokens ThemeExtension for dark+light, VeriqooType typography, spacing, radius, elevation, motion with reduced-motion helper, VeriqooTheme builders), the VeriqooIcons facade, and the barrel design_system.dart. Grounded in plan.md Token reference and File manifest. Independent of later FEATs except that FEAT-002/003/004 depend on this.
steps: In packages/shared_core run `flutter pub add lucide_icons_flutter` (if it fails to resolve, run `flutter pub add phosphor_flutter` and record which in findings).

Download OFL TTFs via Invoke-WebRequest into packages/shared_core/assets/fonts/: Inter variable from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/inter/Inter%5Bopsz%2Cwght%5D.ttf saved as 'Inter[opsz,wght].ttf'; Inter OFL from .../ofl/inter/OFL.txt saved as Inter-OFL.txt; IBM Plex Mono from .../ofl/ibmplexmono/IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf and IBMPlexMono-Medium.ttf; IBM Plex Mono OFL from .../ofl/ibmplexmono/OFL.txt saved as IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt. If any download fails, abandon bundling: `flutter pub add google_fonts` in shared_core, wire families via GoogleFonts, and leave a `// TODO(fonts): bundle offline` note (do not mix strategies).

Edit packages/shared_core/pubspec.yaml: add dev_dependencies (flutter_test: sdk flutter, flutter_lints: ^5.0.0); add a flutter: section with uses-material-design: true and a fonts: block declaring family Inter (asset assets/fonts/Inter[opsz,wght].ttf) and family IBMPlexMono (Regular weight 400, Medium weight 500). (Skip the fonts: block only in the google_fonts fallback.)
Create packages/shared_core/analysis_options.yaml mirroring apps/user_app/analysis_options.yaml: include package:flutter_lints/flutter.yaml with analyzer.exclude for build/** etc.

Create theme/veriqoo_colors.dart (VeriqooColors primitive ramp: black #000000, deepBlack #0A0A0A, charcoal #111111, graphite #181818, borderStrongDark #2A2A2A, midGrey #5E5E5E, lightGrey #A0A0A0, borderGrey #D5D5D5, offWhite #F5F5F2, white #FFFFFF).

Create theme/veriqoo_tokens.dart: VeriqooTokens extends ThemeExtension<VeriqooTokens> with dark (primary) and light instances per plan.md semantic token table; implement copyWith + lerp; expose brightness; add doc comments documenting WCAG contrast (textSecondary passes AA; textTertiary 3.05:1 dark / 2.39:1 light -> restrict to large/decorative/disabled only).

Create theme/veriqoo_typography.dart (VeriqooType: family constants packages/shared_core/Inter and packages/shared_core/IBMPlexMono; display 52/-1.5/w600/1.02, h1 32/-0.5/w700/1.1, h2 24/-0.25/w600/1.2, h3 20/0/w600/1.3, bodyL 16/0/w400/1.5, body 14/0/w400/1.5, caption 13/0/w400/1.4, meta 11.5/letterSpacing 1.61/w500/1.2 uppercase, mono 13 IBM Plex Mono with FontFeature.tabularFigures()).

Create theme/veriqoo_spacing.dart (4,8,12,16,24,32,48,64,80,96), theme/veriqoo_radius.dart (none=0, sm=6, md=10, lg=20 + BorderRadius helpers), theme/veriqoo_elevation.dart (one softShadow List<BoxShadow> for floating nav+modals; one restrained translucentSurface token), theme/veriqoo_motion.dart (durations fast=160/base=240/slow=320/cinematic=700 ms; enter=easeOutCubic, move=easeInOutCubic, press=no-overshoot spring; reduceMotion(context) honoring MediaQuery.disableAnimations + platform reduce-motion flag).

Create theme/veriqoo_theme.dart (VeriqooTheme.dark / VeriqooTheme.light building ThemeData with fontFamily Inter, extensions:[VeriqooTokens...], TextTheme from VeriqooType, scaffoldBackgroundColor from tokens.bg, no surface tint).

Create foundations/veriqoo_icons.dart (VeriqooIcons facade with named getters home/scan/history/profile/back/check/close/search/alert/camera/upload etc. mapped to the chosen Lucide package; the ONLY file importing the raw icon package).
Create packages/shared_core/lib/design_system/design_system.dart barrel exporting all theme files + foundations/veriqoo_icons.dart.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter pub get` exits 0 in packages/shared_core AND in apps/user_app.
VeriqooTokens exposes complete dark + light instances with all 11 semantic tokens and valid copyWith/lerp.
Font families are the bundled packages/shared_core/Inter and packages/shared_core/IBMPlexMono (or GoogleFonts in the documented fallback).
The barrel design_system.dart compiles and re-exports the theme layer + VeriqooIcons.
findings:
ICON PACKAGE: lucide_icons_flutter resolved at 3.1.21 (primary choice; phosphor_flutter fallback NOT needed). Import path is 'package:lucide_icons_flutter/lucide_icons.dart' and the class is `LucideIcons`. Icon names used in VeriqooIcons facade: house(home), scanLine(scan), history, user(profile), arrowLeft(back), x(close), chevronRight, settings, search, check, triangleAlert(alert), circleCheck(verified), circleX(violation), camera, upload. All exist in 3.1.21. VeriqooIcons is the ONLY file importing the raw package. Later FEATs: add icon getters here (do not import lucide elsewhere).

FONTS: Bundled strategy used (NOT the google_fonts fallback). TTFs downloaded via Invoke-WebRequest into packages/shared_core/assets/fonts/: 'Inter[opsz,wght].ttf' (variable, 876576 bytes), IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf (135580), IBMPlexMono-Medium.ttf (136704), plus Inter-OFL.txt and IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt licenses. pubspec declares family `Inter` (single variable asset) and family `IBMPlexMono` (Regular weight 400, Medium weight 500). EXACT FONT FAMILY STRINGS to use in TextStyle.fontFamily: kInterFamily = 'packages/shared_core/Inter', kMonoFamily = 'packages/shared_core/IBMPlexMono' (exported from theme/veriqoo_typography.dart). ThemeData.fontFamily is set to kInterFamily in VeriqooTheme. NOTE: the PowerShell bracket filename needs -LiteralPath handling (brackets are wildcards).

TOKENS: VeriqooTokens ThemeExtension exposes 11 semantic colors (bg, bgTrue, surface, surfaceRaised, borderHairline, borderStrong, textPrimary, textSecondary, textTertiary, inverseBg, inverseText) + brightness, with copyWith + lerp. Static instances VeriqooTokens.dark (primary) and VeriqooTokens.light. Read via Theme.of(context).extension<VeriqooTokens>()!. borderHairline dark = Color(0x1AFFFFFF) (white @10%). WCAG: textTertiary fails AA for body text (dark 3.05:1 / light 2.39:1) -> restrict to large/decorative/disabled/meta only (documented in veriqoo_tokens.dart).

ELEVATION: VeriqooElevation.softShadow (List<BoxShadow>, floating nav + modals only) and VeriqooElevation.translucentSurface (Color(0x990A0A0A)). MOTION: VeriqooMotion durations fast=160/base=240/slow=320/cinematic=700 ms; curves enter=easeOutCubic, move=easeInOutCubic, press=easeOutCubic (no overshoot) + pressSpring (critically damped SpringDescription); reduceMotion(context) uses MediaQuery.maybeDisableAnimationsOf(context) ?? false. RADIUS: VeriqooRadius none/sm=6/md=10/lg=20 + noneAll/smAll/mdAll/lgAll + top(radius) helper. SPACING: VeriqooSpacing s4..s96.

BARREL: packages/shared_core/lib/design_system/design_system.dart (library; export only). Currently exports the 8 theme files + foundations/veriqoo_icons.dart. Later FEATs append painters/motif/components/gallery exports here. Import as 'package:shared_core/design_system/design_system.dart'.

VERIFICATION: `flutter pub get` exit 0 in both packages/shared_core and apps/user_app. `flutter analyze` in packages/shared_core -> 'No issues found!' (0 errors, 0 warnings). Removed two unnecessary-import lints (dart:ui and flutter/physics are re-exported by flutter/widgets). services/ left untouched. No commits made.
